question: Can a span controller generalize the portion of its measured treatment effect that reaches the reader as text written only under that skill? Use privileged paired reader measurements while training. At inference the actor sees only the current physical pre-write state and native logit.
population: Use the frozen 60 contrasts in the joint-mask fit, 12 factorial windows with 91 distinct questions and 12 randomized donor windows with 88 distinct questions across six training histories. Keep the joint-mask exclusion for pending same-skill capped-source faults and every verified writer-block veto. Collect a measurement even for masked rows, but preserve their zero training targets. No label from the later 378 questions or independent histories may enter the fit.
intervention: Align the two factual readers by retrieved rank. A different rank is direct when either text was last written at the focal span and that exact text was absent from the opposite bank immediately after that span. The rest of the rank changes form the second group. Swap the direct positions reciprocally without re-retrieval, sorting or deduplication; ignore padding after the swap. Rebuild the two original reader prompts, check raw physical responses, exact request keys, token counts, traces and corpus scores. Aliases of either original endpoint are exact measured hybrids. Measure both remaining hybrid prompts on the same bounded physical Llama reader, with the original backend identity for each panel. A rank-block decomposition depends on this grouping; it does not isolate semantics or rule out changes in later skills. Include all physical contrasts, including unchanged and zero-return questions.
training: With four physical returns decompose the total using the two-order Shapley average for direct rank changes. The residual is total minus direct. Transfer direct via the current source half of the pre-write state, and residual via the full source-and-memory vector, separately by root/terminal stage. Split existing signed rule-2 credit in proportion to the positive alignment of these two components with the signed credit. This cannot increase total credit or create a label on an abstention. Keep raw returns for ordinary policy learning. Freeze two separate datasets: aliases only, transferring unresolved direct components via the unsplit full-state learner, and complete after all hybrids. Gaussian-free positive-cosine power eight, prior weight one, equal-history weights, add effect / 0.05 clipped to two native log-odds. Compare identical split model trained on raw return alone, unsplit verified kernel, native, terminal PPO, and a stage/weight/held-training-history-preserving rotation of the direct components. The actual test state contains neither the downstream question nor its memory reads.
evaluation: Measure held-history focal probabilities, focal F1 and joint HT F1, reader costs and prompt provenance. Report the 88 retrospective randomized donor questions and the fixed 40-window/378-question training-history evaluation separately with a strict post-freeze subset; archive partial paths at freeze. Fit matched-use constant offsets by pivot without using outcomes. Require the complete physical decomposition and all 378 questions, +0.02 focal F1 over both native and terminal, positive joint HT difference, positive focal gains over raw, unsplit, rotated and matched use, at least four histories above matched use and positive prospective gain over native and raw. Only then evaluate independent development and the two locked full-history benchmarks.
